scope: Validation-only diagnostic audit; no optimization, gate amendment, selection change or test reads
precision: FP32, autocast disabled; eval/no_grad; batch 2 for all; common unaugmented tensors
metrics: Existing DepthMetricAccumulator, pooled and per-path; GT finite inclusive [.1,1000]; near GT<10; original depth bands [.1,10),[10,50),[50,100),[100,300),[300,1000]
supplementary: Near signed bias/MAE/signed-relative bias and exact per-path error quantiles
Near predicted>=10m, overestimate>=2m and underestimate<=-2m rates
Near-error spatial maps and fixed 3x3 regional metrics
Saved A/B history only for epoch persistence; no other checkpoint promotion
example_selection: Per path, eligible frames have >=64 valid near pixels; typical is nearest median teacher near AbsRel; poor is maximum teacher near AbsRel; regression is maximum teacher-minus-A near SSE; ties earliest frame; deterministic dedup. All validation frames remain in metrics.
guards: ImageReadGuard allowlist contains VAL only, installed before any image operation; no discovery; explicit path checks; failing HDD path denied; checkpoints/source buffers hashed before and after
next_experiment: Proposal only after observations; never launched
